instructions.name_scope: Helper semantic names are inferred from committed symbol mappings and corresponding owned enrollee evidence; control flow and literal message/state values are instruction-inspected.

owned_cpu: EAP server identity/start and request identifier sequencing
EAP-WSC fragment emission, reassembly and fragment acknowledgements
PIN and PBC M1-M8 registrar negotiation
Concrete DH1536, HMAC, password commitments and authenticated AES settings through station crypto::wps
Original AP credentials encoded only after E-SNonce2 proof
Registered outcome only after nonce-bound WSC Done
Selected-registrar advertisement enable/disable, real entropy requests, timeout, cached request retry, cancellation and disconnect effects
canonical_integration: AP integration contract: hold a concrete Registrar instance; fulfill RegistrarEffect::Entropy through owned station crypto::random::RandomPool::generate and RtosClock samples; drain transmit, selected-registrar, timer and disconnect effects before publishing terminal outcomes. No hardware-TRNG or cryptographic CPU callback is required. The stock clock-byte/pool generator does not establish cryptographic entropy strength.
teardown_boundary: Registrar::is_drained reports no queued engine effects. AP separately tracks issued physical effects and their acknowledgements before StopBss.
synthetic_tests: wireless_station_wps_registrar_tests.rs drives actual enrollee and registrar engines through PIN and PBC exchanges and checks wrong-PIN rejection, timeout, cancellation, initial configured/setup-locked advertisement, retained PIN authorization after advertisement expiry and exact request retransmission. Test frames and credentials are synthetic.
